_about: What verify/from-waha.js world-eaters cannot take from Wahapedia's pages as they are, each with its reason (docs/catalog.md): detachmentNames, a detachment GW's documents name otherwise than Wahapedia's heading (GW's name is the detachment's; Wahapedia's is kept as its waha, to find its section); detachmentTexts, GW's words where its Faction Pack prints a detachment otherwise than Wahapedia's page. aiRead: the catalogue's AI layers are written (its detachments' gists, its rows' summaries and readings: ai), so a phone import of any of its datasheets shows complete sheets; verify/catalog-armies.js places them for the gate.

Possessed Slaughterband.why: GW's World Eaters Faction Pack 1.3 (30 Sep 2026), Rules Updates, names the detachment POSSESSED SLAUGHTERBOUND (its section heading "POSSESSED SLAUGHTERBOUND DETACHMENT", with the Warp Stalkers, Rapid Manifestation and Brazen Fury updates); Wahapedia's faction page heads it "Possessed Slaughterband 2DP". GW is the source of truth (the owner's rule): GW's name, Wahapedia's kept as waha to find its section. The coordinator's decision of 23 Nov 2026.

brazen-engines.why: GW's World Eaters Faction Pack 1.3 prints the Brazen Engines detachment in full (p2): "WORLD EATERS VEHICLE unit only. This unit has DAEMON." with its full stop; Wahapedia's page has none. GW's words (verify/texts.js checks the detachment against the pack).

Idol of Blessed Blood.sumOv: At the start of each battle round, if the Khorne Lord of Skulls is on the battlefield: roll one additional D6 for the Blessings of Khorne roll

Blood-hungry Annihilator.sumAtk: vs the closest eligible MONSTER or VEHICLE target within 18", ranged: re-roll Wound rolls and Damage rolls

Punishing Suppression.sumDef: If the attacker is suppressed (one non-MONSTER/VEHICLE enemy unit picked after the Chaos Predator Destructor hit it in your Shooting phase): −1 to Hit rolls

Airborne Predator.sumAtk: vs units that can FLY: +1 to Hit rolls

Frenzy.sumDef: Once per turn, after an enemy unit fights this unit, if it uses this ability: this unit fights next, even if it has already fought

Savage Exaltation.sumAtk: In melee, vs enemy units below Starting Strength: +1 to Hit rolls; also +1 to Wound rolls if they are Below Half-strength

The Scent of Blood.sumSt: When this unit declares a charge, if an enemy unit below Starting Strength is within 9": +1 to Charge rolls (+2 if it is Below Half-strength)

Idols of Khorne.sumAtk: Idol of Infinite Rage (Aura) ⇒ If Idol of Infinite Rage is active, within 6" of a WORLD EATERS MONSTER or 9" of a WORLD EATERS TITANIC unit: +1 to Hit rolls and +1 to Wound rolls
Idols of Khorne.sumDef: If Idol of Blessed Blood is active, within 6" of a WORLD EATERS MONSTER or 9" of a WORLD EATERS TITANIC unit: 4+ invulnerable save
Idols of Khorne.sumSt: If Idol of Burning Wrath is active, within 6" of a WORLD EATERS MONSTER or 9" of a WORLD EATERS TITANIC unit: +1" Move; +1 to Advance and Charge rolls
Idols of Khorne.sumOv: In your Command phase, pick one Idols of Khorne ability for WORLD EATERS MONSTER and TITANIC units until your next Command phase, each once per battle: Idol of Infinite Rage, Idol of Burning Wrath or Idol of Blessed Blood

Butcher Lord.sumOv: The bearer has the Infiltrators ability

Strategic Slaughter.sumOv: After deployment: redeploy up to three JAKHALS and/or GOREMONGERS units, Strategic Reserves allowed whatever their number

Bloody Vengeance.gist: when a WORLD EATERS MONSTER or TITANIC unit is destroyed by an enemy unit: JAKHALS and GOREMONGERS can re-roll Hit rolls vs that enemy unit

Drawn to the Slaughter.gist: once per battle, when a JAKHALS unit is destroyed: an identical unit at Starting Strength goes into Strategic Reserves (not CHARACTER units of Attached units)

In the Shadow of Brass Idols.gist: JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS, when targeted: Feel No Pain 6+ (5+ within 6" of a WORLD EATERS MONSTER or 9" of a WORLD EATERS TITANIC)

Bloodthirsty Horde.gist: JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS models within 3" of enemy models can fight, attacking an enemy unit within 3" of them and in Engagement Range of their unit

Fail Not the Blood God.gist: JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS: re-roll Hit rolls of 1 (all Hit rolls within 6" of a WORLD EATERS MONSTER or 9" of a WORLD EATERS TITANIC)

Brazen Idol.gist: once per battle: a WORLD EATERS MONSTER or TITANIC unit has the Idol of Infinite Rage, Burning Wrath or Blessed Blood instead of the army’s, even one already used

Daemonic Resistance.gist: WORLD EATERS POSSESSED, when targeted: −1 to Wound rolls for attacks on this unit

Daemonic Strength.gist: WORLD EATERS POSSESSED: +1 Damage vs models not MONSTER/VEHICLE if EIGHTBOUND, vs MONSTER/VEHICLE models if EXALTED EIGHTBOUND

Immortal Fury.gist: WORLD EATERS POSSESSED, when targeted: models destroyed before they have fought fight after the attacking unit, then are removed

Rapid Manifestation.gist: an EXALTED EIGHTBOUND unit arriving by Deep Strike can be set up more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units; it cannot charge this turn

Warp Stalkers.gist: a WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit moves through enemy models (not MONSTERS/VEHICLES) and ends only a Charge move within Engagement Range of them; Desperate Escape tests are passed automatically

Horrifying Violence.gist: each enemy unit in Engagement Range of a WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit takes a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1

Rush to the Fray.sumAtk: If this unit disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn: melee [LANCE]
Rush to the Fray.sumSt: If this unit disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn: +1 to Charge rolls

Aggressive Deployment.sumOv: If the bearer starts the battle embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT: that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has Scouts 9"

Unleash Hell.sumDef: If the attacker is suppressed (one enemy unit picked after a VEHICLE within 6" of the bearer, or the bearer’s TRANSPORT, selected at the start of your Shooting phase, hit it): −1 to Hit rolls

Infernal Infusion.sumOv: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, if used: the bearer’s unit has Fights First

Endless Pursuit of Violence.gist: a WORLD EATERS INFANTRY unit wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT it can embark within embarks in it

Smash Through.gist: a WORLD EATERS VEHICLE moves horizontally through terrain features on Normal and Advance moves

Aggressive Disembarkation.gist: one WORLD EATERS unit disembarks from a WORLD EATERS RHINO, set up wholly within 6" of it, within Engagement Range allowed

Full-Throttle Assault.gist: a WORLD EATERS unit disembarking from this WORLD EATERS RHINO after its Normal move makes an assault disembark move

Unrelenting Advance.gist: a WORLD EATERS VEHICLE hit by an enemy unit’s attacks makes a Normal move of up to 6" (not with Fury Unleashed in the same phase)

Fury Unleashed.gist: a KHORNE BERZERKERS unit embarked within a WORLD EATERS RHINO that was hit makes a disembark move, then a surge move of up to D6+2" (not with Unrelenting Advance in the same phase)

Apoplectic Clarity.gist: a DAEMON VEHICLE’s attacks ignore modifiers to BS, WS, Hit rolls and Wound rolls

Goaded to Fury.gist: an unengaged DAEMON VEHICLE (not TITANIC) that an enemy unit shot makes a surge move of up to D6"
